newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Aug investment in China down 47 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Aug investment in China down 47 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Taiwan's economics ministry on Wednesday said it approved US$122.7 million worth of investment projects in China for August, down 47 percent from July.
In the first eight months of 1996, Taiwanese investment projects in China totalled $909.6 million, up 23 percent from the same period a year ago, the ministry said in a statement.

Between January and August, investment in electronic and electric manufacturing rose 45 percent from a year earlier to $210 million, followed by investment in transport equipment that rose 41 percent to $90.8 million.
Investment in the chemical industry rose 12 percent to $86 million, and investment in food manufacturing gained 16 percent to $85.5 million.
Taiwanese investment in the textile industry in China increased 30 percent to $69 million, the statement said.

Taiwan has banned direct contact of any kind with China since the two were separated by a civil war in 1949. All Taiwanese investment in China must be routed through a third region, usually Hong Kong, with government approval.
